description: Change one of the den's settings in /opt/epeaky/.env (a backup first), then restart it. An empty value removes the setting. Only these: DEN_ENTRY (invite, approval or external, comma-separated); DEN_ROOMS (id:Title pairs, comma-separated (ids: a-z, 0-9, -)); DEN_DONATE (an https:// address); DEN_DONATE_LABEL (1 to 40 characters); DEN_ISSUER_LABEL (1 to 40 characters); DEN_SCREEN (on or off); DEN_SCREEN_BITRATE (bits a second, 300000 to 8000000); DEN_RETENTION_DAYS (days, 1 to 3650); DEN_LIMITS (name=number pairs (message_bytes, file_max, file_bytes, files, room_members, invites, inbox, history_bytes, min_free_bytes)); DEN_PUBLIC_IP (an IPv4 or IPv6 address). This changes the server: Ask your human first, and tell them what it does.

server.description: The server as user@host (its address or name), reachable with your human's SSH key.
